audio: Onset-aligned recorded SAW and carbine banks with three real takes, clearer opposing reports, and geometry-driven early facade reflections. Existing source/listener-aware rooms, indirect hearing, distance-delayed reports and real projectile near-passes remain. Performed voices, ambient menu and existing music assets retained.

mobile.camera: Controlled soldier stays centered in the usable area between HUD and thumb controls, including world edges and zoom transitions
mobile.guidance: Healthy world names and roles appear in Simple only; Expert removes routine world labels and coaching while preserving target markers and critical casualty cues

desktop.camera: stable by default; camera and mouse input share one transform
desktop.aim: single adjustable reticle with optional cover cue
desktop.performance: cached effects, cropped map rendering, bounded render buffers, change-only HUD updates
desktop.diagnostics: F3: FPS, frame time and actual Canvas 2D buffer dimensions

buildings.entry: Open north/south doorways, widened frontages, or explosive gaps in qualifying perimeter sections
buildings.interiors: shared walls, room partitions, decorative furnishings and automatic roof cutaways
buildings.sharedCollision: solo, AI navigation, bullets, sight lines, desktop aim and co-op prediction

destruction.scope: Localized side-wall cuts and doorway-adjacent frontage damage; corner supports, remaining walls, partitions and roof stay intact; no structural collapse

squad.soloSelection: HUD cards or keyboard 1–4, retaining each soldier state
squad.grenadier: slower; four launcher rounds and directional binoculars

worldVariation: Seeded building footprints, alleys, courtyards and district details; fixed mission routes and anchors
visibility: Shared current sight and subtle remembered terrain; walls/smoke occlude contacts

enemies.encounters: Finite groups at authored approaches; no random around-player reinforcement ring

story.continuation: Bounded supply costs, fatigue and civilian communication consequences across the four campaign chapters; fresh actor state each chapter; side operations remain independent
story.historicalFraming: fictional choices and composite encounters within documented raid-to-rescue context

casualties.bodies: persist until new mission or restart
casualties.blood: short hit spurts, persistent ground marks and small pools
casualties.visibility: shared sight, smoke, roofs, then stationary terrain memory

acoustics.environmentResponses: Two cached procedural stereo response kernels: short dense room reflections and later spaced street reflections
acoustics.environmentGeometry: Source and listener rooms, walls, openings and breaches select the response; bounded approximation, not a full acoustic solver

earlyStreetReflections.geometry: Remaining exterior wall fragments; openings and breaches remove their reflecting surface
earlyStreetReflections.delay: Extra reflected-path travel after the direct arrival
earlyStreetReflections.voicePriority: Below direct reports; shares the 32-voice budget
earlyStreetReflections.indoorsAndOccluded: Use the existing room and indirect sound treatment

recordedWeaponTakes.source: Edited and separately shaped M249 recordings by Baelphazoar, CC BY 4.0; full attribution in audio/CREDITS.txt

missionSelection.continuation: Chronological campaign only; Dawn Mile completes the campaign

navigation.routes: Clearance-aware paths through doors and breaches, reachable destinations, and recovery from blocked movement
navigation.civilians: Threatened residents seek reachable shelter, remain sheltered through nearby danger, or cower if immobilized; rescued residents follow escort routes

nightEffects.trigger: Actual shot events at weapon positions
nightEffects.illumination: Brighter night-only muzzle cores and broader warm light pools; brief shot-driven peaks, wall/roof/smoke visibility gates, cached sprites and bounded shot geometry
nightEffects.reducedMotion: Retains a dimmer muzzle core without local glow
nightEffects.sourceFlash: Visible night sources require unobstructed squad sight; no persistent marker or terrain revelation
